annotations.title: Add the planned cron job monitor

description: Use this when the user has confirmed a plan_cron_monitor plan. Returns the job's ping URL and ready-to-paste code for crontab, start/complete/fail reporting, GitHub Actions, a Kubernetes CronJob and a systemd timer. Spends one monitor. Safe to repeat: the same plan id returns the first result and the same URL. Not for changing an existing job's schedule: use update_monitor.

confirm.description: The plan's confirm sentence, exactly as returned; show it to the user first.
